history.summary: A 2009 999-yr leasehold 2BR (1,076 sqft, a generous size for the bracket) in West Coast D05 near One-North, with a solid 72-txn URA series at 4.66%/yr. Asking $1,848 PSF is modestly above the $1,807 median, and the ~$2M quantum sits at the edge of the liquid band, but the One-North job-hub catalyst and near-freehold tenure are genuine.
history.rating_rationale: Reliable data (72 txns, 4.66%/yr above the implied baseline), 999-yr near-freehold tenure, on_frontier=true, and a roomy 1,076 sqft 2BR in the One-North/West Coast growth corridor. Asking $1,848 PSF is only ~2% over the $1,807 median — fair. The ~$2.0M quantum is the main caution (top of the liquid band) and the listing shows no MRT proximity, but D05's tech-job demand underpins both rent and resale.

catalysts: One-North / West Coast tech and biomedical job hub driving tenant and buyer demand
